summary: Iteration 2: Verified Emergent Google OAuth integration on KeldersVisuals. Backend cookie-based session auth, legacy admin JWT fallback, admin/user route guards, per-user booking scoping, and logout session deletion all working. Frontend: /login shows Google button, nav shows Inloggen when logged out, /admin and /mijn-account both redirect to /login when unauth, admin dashboard renders when a valid ADMIN session cookie is injected, MyAccount renders for authenticated user, booking wizard still fully public.
passed: POST /api/auth/session with fake session_id -> 401 (Emergent returned 401 as expected)
POST /api/admin/login legacy JWT works with lorenzokelders222@gmail.com / KeldersAdmin2026!; wrong password -> 401
GET /api/admin/bookings with legacy Bearer JWT -> 200 list
Cookie session via mongo insertion for ADMIN email: /api/auth/me returns is_admin=true; /api/admin/bookings -> 200; PATCH /api/admin/bookings/{id} updates booking_status+payment_status
Non-admin cookie session: /api/auth/me returns is_admin=false; /api/admin/bookings -> 403; /api/me/bookings returns only that user's bookings; booking created while authed carries user_id
POST /api/bookings unauth still works (public flow) and stores user_id=null
Frontend nav shows Inloggen (data-testid=nav-login-cta) when logged out
Frontend /mijn-account without login -> redirect to /login (MyAccount Navigate)
Frontend booking wizard /boeken loads unauthenticated (step 1 with 8 service tiles)
Frontend with injected admin session_token cookie: /admin renders admin-bookings-list, nav-user-menu shows 'Owner'; /mijn-account shows account-name='Owner'
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com but the auth playbook link in codebase comment says do not hardcode — the URL is hardcoded (necessary for OAuth). This matches the standard Emergent pattern and is expected; not a bug.
auth/session cookie is set with samesite='none' + secure=True which is correct for cross-site OAuth callback flows in preview env.
get_current_user does not extend session expiry on activity — sessions will hard-expire at 7 days. Acceptable for MVP.
MyAccount.jsx does not guard against api.get('/me/bookings') 401 — if session expires while page is open, error is swallowed silently (busy stays false, bookings empty). Minor UX.
AuthContext.logout doesn't await api.post - but that's fine because it uses try/catch; however the returned user state is cleared even if the request fails — acceptable.
